flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/Report/index.tsx + pages/Report/action/ActionReport.tsx (four Court Report entries as stubs), pages/Report/lists/ReportList.tsx (does not list court), pages/NoticeSearch/hook/useSearch.ts (courtmention endpoint client), utils/models/Icourtmention.d.ts. ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsCourtCase, workflows/cas_integration, resources/api-authorization.properties (lists /v1/courtmention etc. with no controller). ocmsadminprivateapi workflows/jobreport (generic cron execution report), datahivecontactinfo/hstreport (other reports). ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no related code
note: Sheet status: Demo paid (50% of 75%); the demo remark mentions SFTP and a code split. The story asks OCMS to generate summary reports on summonses (returned, processed, errors, mention generation files) for the Court Processing Officer. The staff portal only has four court report names (Court Application Vault, Court Application Submit, Court Summon, Court Rejected) as stubs: empty path, resource 'courtcasesummary' commented out, not in ReportList.tsx. There is no controller, service, entity or cron for summon, courtmention, courttrial or courtcasesummary in ocmsadminapi/ocmsadminprivateapi, although api-authorization.properties:23 and useSearch.ts:99-110 refer to /v1/courtmention. The returned/processed summons and mention generation files to be reported on do not exist either (see OCMS24.6, 24.9, 24.10). Searched with synonyms summon, mention, court report, courtcasesummary, shortlist. No relevant maintenance ticket. SFTP: cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. Only report-name stubs in the UI; no data source, generator or court report cron. Ask URA/the team to confirm where the code lives (SFTP demo) or mark as a gap.

steps.step: The Court Processing Officer has processed approved applications and mention cases in OCMS
steps.detail: Application and mention-case processing does not exist in the backend: there is no summon, courtmention or courttrial entity/controller. The UI calls endpoint 'courtmention' (useSearch.ts:109) and api-authorization.properties:23 lists /v1/courtmention, but no controller or entity serves it in ocmsadminapi. Only ocms_court_case (payment due date) and the CAS endpoint casUpdateCourtNotices exist, not mention processing.

steps.step: OCMS generates a summary report of returned summonses
steps.detail: The staff portal Report page has four court entries (Court Application Vault, Court Application Submit, Court Summon, Court Rejected) but only as stubs: empty path, the 'courtcasesummary' endpoint is commented out, and ReportList.tsx does not list them. There is no data source for returned summonses.

steps.step: OCMS generates a summary report of processed summonses
steps.detail: The 'Court Summon Reports' entry is only a stub (empty path, resource commented out). There is no query or generator for a processed-summons report, and no summon table in the API.

steps.step: OCMS generates a report of processing errors
steps.detail: The 'Court Rejected Reports' entry is only a stub (the type R/RE filter is commented out). No court-processing error is recorded in the backend. A generic cron error report (jobreport/JobExecutionReportJob) exists but covers cron execution, not court errors.

steps.step: OCMS generates a report of the mention generation files produced
steps.detail: No code generates mention files, so there is nothing to report; no report entry exists for mention generation at all (the four court entries above do not cover it). See OCMS24.9 and OCMS24.10.
